name: com.uee03.pretzel.camera
description: Camera tools on Cinemachine 3 for 2D, 2.5D and 3D: a trauma-based screen shake and a playfield fit that keep any aspect ratio correct, both as allocation-free Cinemachine extensions, plus menu entries that build a ready camera rig. The math is plain C# and unit tested.

samples.description: A 2D arena with a Cinemachine follow camera, trauma shake on click and a playfield that fits every aspect ratio.
